experiment: A9 real concurrent TOCTOU race: state-bound clock vs caller-chosen timestamp

real_case.interpretation: the real, state-bound ledger clock read (ledgerNow->GetState(clock:now)) was genuinely included in this transaction's MVCC read-set; the concurrent SetClock write to the same key caused Fabric to correctly invalidate this transaction at commit time -- real TOCTOU protection working

ablated_case.interpretation: GetTxTimestamp() (caller-chosen) was used instead of ledgerNow(); no GetState(clock:now) call means no MVCC read-set entry for the clock key at all -- the concurrent SetClock write had zero effect, the transaction committed successfully regardless -- the real consequence of A9
